ValidationRule.description: Stage gate: Delivery, Kickoff done and later stages need Access received and Scope summary.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(CASE(Stage__c, "Onboarding", 1, "Kickoff done", 2, "First deliverables", 3, "Steady state", 4, "At risk", 5, "Wrapping up", 6, "Completed", 7, 0) >= 2, OR(NOT(Access_received__c), ISBLANK(Scope_summary__c)))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Fill in Access received and Scope summary before moving to Kickoff done.
